name: Reef Check Malaysia
summary: Brings divers, communities, government and business together to monitor, manage and restore Malaysia's coral reefs and marine ecosystems.
programmes: Community marine conservation groups on islands
EcoDiver training and International Coastal Cleanup
impact: 6,617 coral fragments rescued and planted across 11 sites in 2025
49,460 kg of waste collected and 3,356 kg of ghost nets removed in 2025
beneficiaries: Coral reefs and island communities in Tioman, Mersing, Redang, Semporna, Mantanani and south Johor

organisation.leadership: Julian Hyde, CEO; Theresa Ng, COO; Alvin Chelliah, Chief Programmes Officer; Jasmin Mohd Saad, Chief Public Policy and Advocacy Officer
